standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings and welcome to my pickaxe shop. Do you want to buy my premium quality pickaxes?

options.text: Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?

steps.player: Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?

steps.npc: Of course they are! My pickaxes are made of higher grade metal than your ordinary bronze pickaxes, allowing you to mine that ore just a little bit faster than normal.

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.player: Hi Nurmof, I found this earlier...

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.npc: Oh, a dragon pickaxe! And a broken one at that. I haven't seen one of those in a while.

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.player: Can you fix it for me? I was told you're the dwarf to see!

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.npc: I did indeed fix pickaxes in the past, many years ago. They were a lot more common back then.
In fact, this is the first broken pickaxe I've seen in a very long time!

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.player: Why were there so many broken pickaxes back then?

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.npc: Ore rocks used to be quite unstable. They would randomly explode when you were mining them.
It was. But then one day, the explosions just... stopped. As if someone flipped an off switch somewhere.
I've not seen a broken pickaxe since then!

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.player: Will you still be able to fix mine for me?

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.npc: I should think so. I'll need to buy some new tools.
They're quite expensive, but they will get the job done. The pickaxe will be as good as new when I've finished with it.
...let me see. I need another one of these, and I can reuse that if I replace the drill bit from there...
...hmm, and this needs a full clean, oh and I don't have one of those anymore...
...okay! It'll cost about 2,500,000 GP, give or take a few coins. Would you like me to fix it for you?

with-a-dragon-pickaxe-broken-in-inventor.prompt: Pay Nurmof 2,500,000 GP to fix your dragon pickaxe?

steps.npc: Lovely! Okay, give me a moment. It may take a little while, it's a tough metal to work with.

steps.text: If the player has at least 2,500,000 gp in their inventory:
Nurmof goes into a nearby hidden room, and from within, you hear the sound of a hammer striking metal.
..he did say it would take a little while.
Nurmof hands you the repaired dragon pickaxe.

steps.npc: There you go, good as new, just like I said!

steps.player: Thank you very much. I'll take good care of it.

steps.text: If the player has less than 2,500,000 gp in their inventory:

steps.player: Oh, I actually don't have enough coins on me! I'll come back with more.

steps.npc: It is! But you can't cheap out on quality. If a job's worth doing, do it well.
I'm also the only one who can repair pickaxes these days, so you don't really have much choice!

steps.prompt: Pay Nurmof 2,500,000 GP to fix your dragon pickaxe?
